description: Created an interactive 3D Lunar base gaming platform that allows users to play and experience real life environments against challenges such as moonwalk training, find the water ice, repair the base and solar storm run.
summary:
We developed Moon Base Rescue Mission, an educational 3D space exploration game where players take on the role of an astronaut on the Moon. The game includes four missions involving lunar exploration, collecting water ice, repairing base systems and surviving a solar storm.

The game addresses the challenges of living on the Moon through interactive missions. Players learn about collecting water ice, maintaining essential systems such as oxygen generators and solar arrays, and staying safe during solar storms. It turns these real space-related challenges into fun, engaging tasks.

Our game helps players understand the difficulties of establishing and surviving at a Moon base. It promotes awareness of space exploration, resource management, problem-solving and scientific concepts through interactive gameplay. It also makes learning about space more interesting and accessible.
details:
Lunar-tots is an interactive, decision-making space exploration game designed to train the next generation of junior astronauts. Player's step into the role of a rookie astronaut navigating realistic space missions, where they must solve challenges, manage resources, and make critical real-time decisions to ensure mission success.

Our primary goal is to make space science accessible, engaging, and fun for younger audiences. By placing students in active leadership roles rather than passive learning environments, the game builds critical thinking, problem-solving skills in this field. Ultimately, we aim to inspire youth to pursue careers in space exploration and aerospace engineering.

To bring this experience to life, our team used Godot, blender for 3D models.

Its uniqueness is because every choice directly impacts the mission's outcome teaching players that failure in space is a learning opportunity rather than just a "game over."

When designing the game, our team carefully considered age-appropriate accessibility by simplifying complex astrophysics and orbital mechanics into intuitive, visual mini-games without losing scientific accuracy. It is built for the younger generation.

We modelled scenarios after actual astronaut training protocols and real NASA missions, so players experience authentic space challenges.
